### nisar/code/s5_eval/_nisar_pit_pool_9t.py
```python
"""Pits with a pool on their floor (lidar), and whether NISAR treats them differently (9t; --area 613590).

User, 2026-11-15: pad 303's pit shows a pool inside, seen at other pits too. Find those pits from lidar,
then compare the seasonal NISAR pit contrasts of pool pits with the other pits.

Pool cue from lidar, inside the inner rim (pit_inside.shp), against a ring 3-10 m outside the outer rim:
  * flat floor: share of 1 m cells with slope < 2 deg
  * weak ground return: median lidar ground intensity, floor / ring (water absorbs the 1064 nm pulse)
  * missing ground: median ground point density, floor / ring
Pool = flat share >= 0.5 and (intensity ratio <= 0.7 or density ratio <= 0.5). Thresholds are a first guess,
set before looking at the radar and reported with the results; pad 303's pit is the visual reference.

Radar: per-pit excess (feature minus decoy median, dB) from the seasonal stack,
nisar/results/<area>/nisar_gslc_stack_pit_vs_ring_and_decoys_per_feature_<area>_slc_5m.csv (5 control spots per pit).
Pool vs other pits: Mann-Whitney U per metric, and a permutation of the pool label (5000).

Writes nisar/results/<area>/nisar_pit_pool_{per_pit,radar}_<area>.csv, nisar_pit_pool_<area>.gpkg,
nisar/results/kml/nisar_pit_pool_<area>.kml
  python nisar/code/s5_eval/_nisar_pit_pool_9t.py [--area 613590]
"""
import importlib
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import geopandas as gpd
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import rasterio
from rasterio.mask import mask
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
seas = importlib.import_module("_nisar_gslc_stack_pad_pit_seasonal_9t")
A = seas.A
ROOT = A.NISAR_ROOT.parent
D1 = ROOT / "data" / A.TAG / "derived" / "1m"
SLOPE, INT, DEN = (D1 / f"{k}_{A.TAG}_1m.tif" for k in ("slope", "intensity_ground", "ground_density"))
FLAT_MIN, INT_MAX, DEN_MAX, PERM, SEED = 0.5, 0.7, 0.5, 5000, 20261115
RES = A.NISAR_ROOT / "results" / A.TAG


def zonal(src, geom):
    try:
        a, _ = mask(src, [geom], crop=True, filled=False)
    except ValueError:
        return np.array([])
    v = a[0].compressed().astype(float)
    return v[np.isfinite(v) & (v != src.nodata)] if src.nodata is not None else v[np.isfinite(v)]


def main():
    outer = seas.read_layer(seas.ANN, "pit_outside").to_crs(seas.CRS).reset_index(drop=True)
    outer["id"] = outer.index
    with rasterio.open(SLOPE) as s:
        lcrs = s.crs
        b = s.bounds
    inner = gpd.read_file(ROOT / "qgis" / "annotations" / "pit_inside.shp").to_crs(lcrs)
    inner = inner.cx[b.left:b.right, b.bottom:b.top]
    inner["geometry"] = inner.geometry.make_valid()   # a few hand-drawn rims self-intersect
    outer_l = outer.to_crs(lcrs)
    outer_l["geometry"] = outer_l.geometry.make_valid()
    j = gpd.sjoin(inner[["geometry"]].reset_index(names="inner_row"), outer_l[["id", "geometry"]], predicate="intersects")
    j["ov"] = [g.intersection(outer_l.geometry.iloc[i]).area for g, i in zip(j.geometry, j.id)]
    j = j.sort_values("ov", ascending=False).drop_duplicates("id")   # one inner rim per outer pit, largest overlap
    rows = []
    with rasterio.open(SLOPE) as sl, rasterio.open(INT) as it, rasterio.open(DEN) as de:
        for r in j.itertuples():
            og = outer_l.geometry.iloc[r.id]
            ring = og.buffer(10).difference(og.buffer(3))
            s = zonal(sl, r.geometry)
            fi, ri = zonal(it, r.geometry), zonal(it, ring)
            fd, rd = zonal(de, r.geometry), zonal(de, ring)
            if len(s) < 3 or len(ri) < 10:
                continue
            rows.append(dict(id=int(r.id), n_floor_cells=len(s), flat_share=float(np.mean(s < 2)),
                             int_ratio=float(np.median(fi) / np.median(ri)) if len(fi) and np.median(ri) > 0 else np.nan,
                             den_ratio=float(np.median(fd) / np.median(rd)) if len(fd) and np.median(rd) > 0 else np.nan,
                             geometry=r.geometry))
    P = gpd.GeoDataFrame(rows, crs=lcrs)
    P["pool"] = (P.flat_share >= FLAT_MIN) & ((P.int_ratio <= INT_MAX) | (P.den_ratio <= DEN_MAX).fillna(False))
    print(f"{A.TAG}: {len(outer)} outer pits, {len(P)} with an inner rim and lidar stats, {int(P.pool.sum())} pool pits", flush=True)

    # 2026-11-23: reads the default 5-control-spot run (user decision); the 40-control run is a stability check
    rad = pd.read_csv(RES / f"nisar_gslc_stack_pit_vs_ring_and_decoys_per_feature_{A.TAG}_slc_5m.csv")
    mets = [c[:-8] for c in rad.columns if c.endswith("_feature")]
    for m in mets:
        rad[m] = rad[m + "_feature"] - rad[m + "_decoy_median"]
    M = P.drop(columns="geometry").merge(rad[["id"] + mets], on="id", how="inner")
    rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED)
    out = []
    for m in mets:
        a, b_ = M.loc[M.pool, m].dropna(), M.loc[~M.pool, m].dropna()
        if len(a) < 3 or len(b_) < 3:
            out.append(dict(metric=m, n_pool=len(a), n_other=len(b_)))
            continue
        d = a.median() - b_.median()
        lab = M.pool.values
        v = M[m].values
        ok = np.isfinite(v)
        null = []
        for _ in range(PERM):
            pl = rng.permutation(lab[ok])
            null.append(np.median(v[ok][pl]) - np.median(v[ok][~pl]))
        out.append(dict(metric=m, n_pool=len(a), n_other=len(b_), median_pool_db=round(a.median(), 3),
                        median_other_db=round(b_.median(), 3), diff_db=round(d, 3),
                        p_mannwhitney=round(mannwhitneyu(a, b_).pvalue, 4),
                        p_perm=round(float(np.mean(np.abs(null) >= abs(d))), 4)))
    R = pd.DataFrame(out)
    print(R.to_string(index=False))
    P.drop(columns="geometry").to_csv(RES / f"nisar_pit_pool_per_pit_{A.TAG}.csv", index=False)
    R.to_csv(RES / f"nisar_pit_pool_radar_{A.TAG}.csv", index=False)
    P.to_file(RES / f"nisar_pit_pool_{A.TAG}.gpkg", driver="GPKG")
    k = P[P.pool].to_crs(4326).copy()
    c = k.geometry.centroid
    k["Name"] = [f"{A.TAG}_pool_pit_{i}" for i in k.id]
    k["Description"] = [f"flat {f:.2f}, intensity ratio {a:.2f}, density ratio {d:.2f}. Centroid {y:.6f}, {x:.6f}"
                        for f, a, d, x, y in zip(k.flat_share, k.int_ratio, k.den_ratio, c.x, c.y)]
    k[["Name", "Description", "geometry"]].to_file(A.NISAR_ROOT / "results" / "kml" / f"nisar_pit_pool_{A.TAG}.kml", driver="KML")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```
### nisar/code/s5_eval/_nisar_slope_motion_9t.py
```python
"""NISAR GSLC summer 2026 stack over 9t: is there slope motion at 25 m, and is it at wells?

Option 3 of the 2026-10-05 "what L-band can do for wells" list.
Slow creep on colluvial slopes can shear a well casing. InSAR averaged over tens of metres can see
creep of millimetres per month when coherence holds (Berardino et al. 2002 is the time-series
standard; this is a simple chain version of it).

Per track, snow-free chain only (2026-06 to 2026-09):
  * consecutive pairs at most MAX_DT_DAYS apart, interferogram s1 * conj(s2) in HH.
  * multilook ML x ML (5 x 5 = 25 m), decimated to a 25 m grid.
  * long-wavelength phase (atmosphere, orbit) removed by subtracting the phase of a
    coherence-weighted LP_M boxcar of the multilooked interferogram.
  * cumulative phase = sum of the wrapped pair phases. This assumes under half a cycle (6 mm)
    of motion per pair, which holds for slow creep.
  * LOS displacement, mm, positive = toward the satellite. Pixels with mean coherence < COH_MIN
    are masked.

Is it real? Tracks 090 and 162 are both ascending with similar look directions, but different
dates. Real ground motion appears in both. Atmosphere and noise do not. So the test is the
correlation between the 090 and 162 displacement maps, by slope class, with a 500 m block
bootstrap for the confidence interval (neighbouring pixels are not independent).
Track 026 is descending. Its correlation with the ascending tracks is reported too; for
downslope motion its sign depends on slope aspect, so it is a weaker check.

  python nisar/code/s5_eval/_nisar_slope_motion_9t.py
"""
import importlib
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import geopandas as gpd
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import rasterio
from rasterio.warp import Resampling, reproject
from scipy.ndimage import uniform_filter

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))
ifg = importlib.import_module("_nisar_gslc_interferogram_pits_9t")
st = ifg.st
from _common import path_for  # noqa: E402

OUT, FIG, CRS, DER = st.OUT, st.FIG, st.CRS, st.SRC
AREA = st.A   # area picked with --area (9t, 613590 or mkf)
SLOPE = AREA.lidar("slope")
DEM = AREA.lidar("dem")
WELLS = AREA.WELLS
ML, LP_M, COH_MIN, SUMMER_FROM, BLOCK_M, B, SEED = 5, 1000.0, 0.45, "2026-06-01", 500.0, 1000, 20261007
SLOPE_BINS = [(0, 5, "flat_lt5deg"), (5, 15, "moderate_5to15deg"), (15, 90, "steep_ge15deg")]
MM_PER_RAD = ifg.MM_PER_RAD
# Maps: displacement in "PuOr" (purple-white-orange, diverging, no green); slope classes as
# greys #2B2F36 / #5B6168 / #8E959B with distinct markers (dataviz validate_palette.js --mode light
# --pairs all, 2026-10-07: worst #8E959B-#5B6168 dE 17.6 deutan and normal; neutral by design).
# Scatter in #1F5FA8.
INK, DOT = "#2B2F36", "#1F5FA8"


def multilook(s1, s2):
    i = s1 * np.conj(s2)
    ok = np.isfinite(i) & (s1 != 0) & (s2 != 0)   # 0 marks "no sample" in the stack
    i = np.where(ok, i, 0)
    p1, p2 = np.where(ok, np.abs(s1) ** 2, 0), np.where(ok, np.abs(s2) ** 2, 0)
    h, w = (i.shape[0] // ML) * ML, (i.shape[1] // ML) * ML
    blk = lambda a: a[:h, :w].reshape(h // ML, ML, w // ML, ML).sum((1, 3))
    num, d1, d2 = blk(i), blk(p1), blk(p2)
    coh = np.abs(num) / np.sqrt(d1 * d2)
    return num, np.where(np.isfinite(coh), coh, 0)


def remove_longwave(num, coh):
    k = int(LP_M / (5 * ML)) | 1
    ph = num / np.where(np.abs(num) > 0, np.abs(num), 1)
    wgt = ph * coh
    lp = uniform_filter(wgt.real, k) + 1j * uniform_filter(wgt.imag, k)
    return np.angle(num * np.conj(lp))


def block_boot_r(a, b, rows, cols, rng):
    bs = int(BLOCK_M / (5 * ML))
    blk = (rows // bs) * 10000 + (cols // bs)
    ub = np.unique(blk)
    groups = [np.nonzero(blk == u)[0] for u in ub]
    rs = []
    for _ in range(B):
        sel = np.concatenate([groups[i] for i in rng.integers(0, len(groups), len(groups))])
        rs.append(np.corrcoef(a[sel], b[sel])[0, 1])
    return np.percentile(rs, [2.5, 97.5]).round(3).tolist()


def main():
    FIG.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED)
    idx, stack, tf, shape = ifg.load_complex()
    pairs = ifg.pairs_of(idx)
    pairs = pairs[pairs.d1 >= SUMMER_FROM].reset_index(drop=True)
    print(pairs[["track", "d1", "d2", "dt_days"]].to_string())
    tf25 = rasterio.Affine(5.0 * ML, 0, tf.c, 0, -5.0 * ML, tf.f)
    shp25 = (shape[0] // ML, shape[1] // ML)

    disp, cohm, span = {}, {}, {}
    for t, g in pairs.groupby("track"):
        # the chain must be one connected run of dates: each pair starts where the last ended
        g = g.sort_values("d1").reset_index(drop=True)
        broken = [(a, b) for a, b in zip(g.d2[:-1], g.d1[1:]) if a != b]
        if broken:
            # keep the longest connected run, report the rest as dropped
            run, runs = [0], []
            for k in range(1, len(g)):
                if g.d1[k] == g.d2[k - 1]:
                    run.append(k)
                else:
                    runs.append(run)
                    run = [k]
            runs.append(run)
            keep = max(runs, key=len)
            print(f"track {t}: date chain broken at {broken}; keeping the longest run of {len(keep)} of {len(g)} pairs")
            g = g.iloc[keep].reset_index(drop=True)
        cum = np.zeros(shp25)
        n_good = np.zeros(shp25)
        cs = []
        for p in g.itertuples():
            num, coh = multilook(stack[p.f1][0], stack[p.f2][0])
            good = coh >= COH_MIN          # a pair contributes only where it is itself coherent
            cum += np.where(good, remove_longwave(num, coh), 0.0)
            n_good += good
            cs.append(coh)
        c = np.mean(cs, 0)
        d = -cum * MM_PER_RAD
        # every pair of the chain must be coherent at the pixel, else the sum has a gap in it
        d[(c < COH_MIN) | (n_good < len(g))] = np.nan
        disp[int(t)], cohm[int(t)] = d, c
        span[int(t)] = dict(first=g.d1.iloc[0], last=g.d2.iloc[-1], n_pairs=len(g),
                            days=int((pd.to_datetime(g.d2.iloc[-1]) - pd.to_datetime(g.d1.iloc[0])).days),
                            coherent_share=round(float(np.mean(c >= COH_MIN)), 3),
                            disp_std_mm=round(float(np.nanstd(d)), 2))
        print(t, span[int(t)])
    missing = [t for t in (90, 162) if t not in disp]
    if missing:
        # the test is 090 against 162; without both there is nothing to compare
        print(f"{AREA.TAG}: no summer pairs on track(s) {missing}; the 090-vs-162 test cannot run")
        return

    with rasterio.open(SLOPE) as r:
        slope = np.full(shp25, np.nan, np.float32)
        src = r.read(1, masked=True).filled(np.nan).astype(np.float32)
        reproject(src, slope, src_transform=r.transform, src_crs=r.crs, src_nodata=np.nan,
                  dst_transform=tf25, dst_crs=CRS, dst_nodata=np.nan, resampling=Resampling.average)

    rows_, cols_ = np.indices(shp25)
    pairs_tr = [(90, 162), (90, 26), (162, 26)]
    res = []
    for a, b in pairs_tr:
        for lo, hi, lab in SLOPE_BINS + [(0, 90, "all")]:
            m = np.isfinite(disp[a]) & np.isfinite(disp[b]) & (slope >= lo) & (slope < hi)
            if m.sum() < 50:
                continue
            x, y = disp[a][m], disp[b][m]
            res.append(dict(tracks=f"{a}_vs_{b}", slope_class=lab, n_pixels_25m=int(m.sum()),
                            pearson_r=round(float(np.corrcoef(x, y)[0, 1]), 3),
                            r_ci95_block500m=block_boot_r(x, y, rows_[m], cols_[m], rng),
                            std_mm_a=round(float(x.std()), 2), std_mm_b=round(float(y.std()), 2)))
    res = pd.DataFrame(res)
    print(res.to_string())

    # spread of displacement by slope class (ascending mean of 090 and 162)
    asc = (disp[90] + disp[162]) / 2
    spread = []
    for lo, hi, lab in SLOPE_BINS:
        m = np.isfinite(asc) & (slope >= lo) & (slope < hi)
        v = asc[m]
        spread.append(dict(slope_class=lab, n_pixels_25m=int(m.sum()), asc_mean_std_mm=round(float(v.std()), 2),
                           asc_mean_p95_abs_mm=round(float(np.percentile(np.abs(v), 95)), 2)))
    spread = pd.DataFrame(spread)
    print(spread.to_string())

    # aspect test on steep slopes. Ascending, right-looking: the radar looks east from the west.
    # Downslope creep on a west-facing slope moves toward the satellite (positive), on an
    # east-facing slope away from it (negative). North- and south-facing creep is mostly unseen.
    with rasterio.open(DEM) as r:
        dem = np.full(shp25, np.nan, np.float32)
        reproject(r.read(1, masked=True).filled(np.nan).astype(np.float32), dem, src_transform=r.transform,
                  src_crs=r.crs, src_nodata=np.nan, dst_transform=tf25, dst_crs=CRS, dst_nodata=np.nan,
                  resampling=Resampling.average)
    gy, gx = np.gradient(dem, 25.0)            # rows run south, so gy is d(z)/d(south)
    east_down = gx < 0                          # z falls to the east: east-facing
    face_e = np.abs(gx) > np.abs(gy)
    aspect = []
    for lab, sel in (("west_facing", face_e & ~east_down), ("east_facing", face_e & east_down),
                     ("north_or_south_facing", ~face_e)):
        m = np.isfinite(asc) & (slope >= 15) & sel
        v = asc[m]
        bs = int(BLOCK_M / (5 * ML))
        blk = (rows_[m] // bs) * 10000 + cols_[m] // bs
        ub = np.unique(blk)
        grp = [v[blk == u] for u in ub]
        boot = [np.concatenate([grp[i] for i in rng.integers(0, len(grp), len(grp))]).mean() for _ in range(B)]
        aspect.append(dict(aspect=lab, n_pixels_25m=int(m.sum()), asc_mean_mm=round(float(v.mean()), 2),
                           ci95_block500m=np.percentile(boot, [2.5, 97.5]).round(2).tolist()))
    aspect = pd.DataFrame(aspect)
    print(aspect.to_string())

    # wells: displacement at DEP wells, and the ones both ascending tracks agree on
    x0, y1 = tf25.c, tf25.f
    x1, y0 = x0 + shp25[1] * 25, y1 - shp25[0] * 25
    w = gpd.read_file(WELLS).to_crs(CRS).cx[x0:x1, y0:y1].copy()
    cc = ((w.geometry.x - x0) / 25).astype(int).clip(0, shp25[1] - 1)
    rr = ((y1 - w.geometry.y) / 25).astype(int).clip(0, shp25[0] - 1)
    w["slope_deg_25m"] = slope[rr, cc]
    for t in disp:
        w[f"los_mm_t{t:03d}"] = disp[t][rr, cc]
    w["los_mm_asc_mean"] = asc[rr, cc]
    sd = float(np.nanstd(asc))
    w["both_asc_same_sign_gt2sd"] = (np.sign(w.los_mm_t090) == np.sign(w.los_mm_t162)) & \
                                    (w.los_mm_t090.abs() > 2 * np.nanstd(disp[90])) & \
                                    (w.los_mm_t162.abs() > 2 * np.nanstd(disp[162]))
    # expected count of that flag by chance, from all coherent pixels
    mm = np.isfinite(disp[90]) & np.isfinite(disp[162])
    chance = float(np.mean((np.sign(disp[90][mm]) == np.sign(disp[162][mm])) &
                           (np.abs(disp[90][mm]) > 2 * np.nanstd(disp[90])) &
                           (np.abs(disp[162][mm]) > 2 * np.nanstd(disp[162]))))
    wc = w[np.isfinite(w.los_mm_asc_mean)]
    well_summary = dict(n_wells_coherent=int(len(wc)), n_flagged=int(wc.both_asc_same_sign_gt2sd.sum()),
                        expected_by_chance=round(len(wc) * chance, 1), chance_rate=round(chance, 4),
                        abs_asc_mm_median_steep=round(float(wc[wc.slope_deg_25m >= 15].los_mm_asc_mean.abs().median()), 2),
                        abs_asc_mm_median_flat=round(float(wc[wc.slope_deg_25m < 5].los_mm_asc_mean.abs().median()), 2),
                        n_wells_steep=int((wc.slope_deg_25m >= 15).sum()), n_wells_flat=int((wc.slope_deg_25m < 5).sum()))
    print(well_summary)

    stem = "nisar_slope_motion"
    res.to_csv(OUT / f"{stem}_tracks_{AREA.TAG}.csv", index=False)
    aspect.to_csv(OUT / f"{stem}_aspect_{AREA.TAG}.csv", index=False)
    spread.to_csv(OUT / f"{stem}_spread_{AREA.TAG}.csv", index=False)
    cols = ["PERMIT_NUM", "WELL_STATU", "OPERATOR", "slope_deg_25m", *[f"los_mm_t{t:03d}" for t in disp],
            "los_mm_asc_mean", "both_asc_same_sign_gt2sd", "geometry"]
    w[cols].to_file(OUT / f"{stem}_wells_{AREA.TAG}.gpkg", layer="dep_wells_los_summer2026", driver="GPKG")
    json.dump(dict(params=dict(ml=ML, lp_m=LP_M, coh_min=COH_MIN, summer_from=SUMMER_FROM, block_m=BLOCK_M, B=B),
                   tracks={str(k): v for k, v in span.items()}, agreement=res.to_dict("records"),
                   spread=spread.to_dict("records"),
                   steep_aspect=aspect.to_dict("records"), wells=well_summary),
              open(OUT / f"{stem}_summary_{AREA.TAG}.json", "w"), indent=2, default=float)
    prof = dict(driver="GTiff", height=shp25[0], width=shp25[1], count=1, dtype="float32", crs=CRS,
                transform=tf25, nodata=np.nan, compress="deflate")
    for t, d in disp.items():
        with rasterio.open(DER / f"{stem}_los_mm_t{t:03d}_{AREA.TAG}.tif",
                           "w", **prof) as o:
            o.write(d.astype(np.float32), 1)

    # figure: three displacement maps, the 090-vs-162 scatter, and r by slope class
    fig = plt.figure(figsize=(15, 9))
    lim = np.nanpercentile(np.abs(np.concatenate([d[np.isfinite(d)] for d in disp.values()])), 98)
    ext = [x0, x1, y0, y1]
    for k, t in enumerate([90, 162, 26]):
        ax = fig.add_subplot(2, 3, k + 1)
        im = ax.imshow(disp[t], cmap="PuOr", vmin=-lim, vmax=lim, extent=ext)
        ax.set_title(f"track {t:03d} {'asc' if t != 26 else 'desc'}, {span[t]['first']} to {span[t]['last']}", fontsize=9)
        ax.set_xticks([]); ax.set_yticks([])
    cb = fig.colorbar(im, ax=fig.axes, fraction=0.02, location="right")
    cb.set_label("LOS displacement, mm (positive toward satellite)")
    ax = fig.add_subplot(2, 3, 4)
    m = np.isfinite(disp[90]) & np.isfinite(disp[162])
    ax.scatter(disp[90][m], disp[162][m], s=2, color=DOT, alpha=0.25)
    ax.set_xlabel("track 090, mm"); ax.set_ylabel("track 162, mm")
    r_all = res[(res.tracks == "90_vs_162") & (res.slope_class == "all")].pearson_r.iloc[0]
    ax.set_title(f"both ascending tracks, r = {r_all}", fontsize=10)
    ax = fig.add_subplot(2, 3, 5)
    mk = {"90_vs_162": "o", "90_vs_26": "s", "162_vs_26": "^"}
    cl = {"90_vs_162": INK, "90_vs_26": "#5B6168", "162_vs_26": "#8E959B"}
    labs = [b[2] for b in SLOPE_BINS]
    for tr, g in res[res.slope_class != "all"].groupby("tracks"):
        g = g.set_index("slope_class").reindex(labs).dropna(subset=["pearson_r"])
        if not len(g):
            continue
        xs = np.array([labs.index(i) for i in g.index]) + {"90_vs_162": -0.15, "90_vs_26": 0, "162_vs_26": 0.15}[tr]
        lo = [r[0] for r in g.r_ci95_block500m]; hi = [r[1] for r in g.r_ci95_block500m]
        ax.errorbar(xs, g.pearson_r, yerr=[g.pearson_r - lo, np.array(hi) - g.pearson_r], fmt=mk[tr],
                    color=cl[tr], capsize=3, label=tr.replace("_vs_", " vs "))
    ax.axhline(0, color="#8E959B", lw=0.8)
    ax.set_xticks(range(len(labs)), [l.replace("_", " ") for l in labs], fontsize=8)
    ax.set_ylabel("correlation between tracks (95% block CI)")
    ax.legend(fontsize=8)
    ax = fig.add_subplot(2, 3, 6)
    ax.axis("off")
    ax.text(0, 0.95, "\n".join([
        f"Coherent share (mean coh ≥ {COH_MIN}):",
        *[f"  track {t:03d}: {span[t]['coherent_share']:.0%}, {span[t]['n_pairs']} pairs" for t in [90, 162, 26]],
        "",
        f"DEP wells on coherent pixels: {well_summary['n_wells_coherent']}",
        f"Flagged by both ascending tracks (> 2 SD, same sign): {well_summary['n_flagged']}",
        f"Expected by chance: {well_summary['expected_by_chance']}",
    ]), va="top", fontsize=10, family="monospace")
    fig.suptitle(f"NISAR L-band summer 2026 line-of-sight displacement, 25 m, 1 km trend removed, {AREA.TAG}", fontsize=12)
    fig.savefig(FIG / f"{stem}_maps_{AREA.TAG}.png", dpi=140, bbox_inches="tight")
    print("done", stem)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```
### nisar/code/s7_analysis/_nisar_naip_chips_9t.py
```python
"""NAIP and lidar chips for NISAR steady-bright targets and for open lidar pads, 9t. Set 2026-11-25.

Why
  The steel test asks whether steady bright pixels fall at wells. This asks the reverse: what are
  the steady bright pixels? Looking at the strongest ones on aerial photos and lidar shows whether
  NISAR locks onto buildings, tanks, pumpjacks, towers or bare radar-facing slopes, with no DEP
  assumptions. The same chips of open pads let equipment be tagged by eye for a verified
  hardware set.

Inputs
  NAIP 2022-06-19, 0.6 m, Microsoft Planetary Computer (public STAC, anonymous SAS token).
  Newest NAIP over 9t; leaf-on. NAIP is NAD83 UTM 17N, within about 1 m of the WGS84 grid used here.
  Lidar RRIM 0.5 m, data/9t/derived/05/rrim_openness_9t_05.tif (2019).
  Targets: nisar/results/9t/nisar_bright_targets_points_9t_slc.gpkg (post-June, lidar-placed stack).
  Pads: nisar/results/9t/nisar_steel_pads_sites_9t_slc.gpkg.

Outputs (nisar/results/9t/figures/)
  nisar_naip_chips_targets_p<k>_9t.png   top 40 targets, ranked by tracks then brightness, 10 per page
  nisar_naip_chips_open_pads_p<k>_9t.png every open pad (canopy < 0.30), 10 per page
  nisar/results/9t/nisar_naip_chips_index_9t.csv  chip number -> target or pad id

Run
  python nisar/code/s7_analysis/_nisar_naip_chips_9t.py
"""
import json
import sys
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

import geopandas as gpd
import matplotlib
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import rasterio
from rasterio.windows import from_bounds

matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt  # noqa: E402

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "nisar" / "code"))
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "notebooks" / "wellsight_v2"))
import _nisar_fig_style as S  # noqa: E402
from _common import path_for  # noqa: E402

RES = ROOT / "nisar" / "results" / "9t"
FIG = RES / "figures"
RRIM = path_for("derived") / "9t" / "derived" / "05" / "rrim_openness_9t_05.tif"
import _nisar_area as A  # noqa: E402
WELLS = A.WELLS
STAC = "https://planetarycomputer.microsoft.com/api/stac/v1/search"
BBOX = "-79.5687,41.4797,-79.5139,41.5195"
HALF = 40.0   # chip half-width, m


def naip_urls():
    q = f"{STAC}?collections=naip&bbox={BBOX}&datetime=2022-06-01/2022-06-30&limit=20"
    feats = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(q))["features"]
    tok = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(
        "https://planetarycomputer.microsoft.com/api/sas/v1/token/naip"))["token"]
    return ["/vsicurl/" + f["assets"]["image"]["href"] + "?" + tok for f in feats]


def read(srcs, x, y):
    for s in srcs:
        b = s.bounds
        if b.left <= x - HALF and x + HALF <= b.right and b.bottom <= y - HALF and y + HALF <= b.top:
            w = from_bounds(x - HALF, y - HALF, x + HALF, y + HALF, s.transform)
            a = s.read([1, 2, 3], window=w, boundless=True)
            return np.moveaxis(a, 0, -1)
    return None


def page(items, srcs, rrim, wells, pads, stem, k):
    S.apply()
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(4, 5, figsize=(7.2, 6.4))
    for j in range(10):
        a_n, a_r = ax[(j // 5) * 2, j % 5], ax[(j // 5) * 2 + 1, j % 5]
        S.map_axes(a_n); S.map_axes(a_r)
        if j >= len(items):
            a_n.axis("off"); a_r.axis("off"); continue
        it = items[j]
        ext = (-HALF, HALF, -HALF, HALF)
        n = read(srcs, it["x"], it["y"])
        if n is not None:
            a_n.imshow(n, extent=ext)
        r = read([rrim], it["x"], it["y"])
        if r is not None:
            a_r.imshow(r, extent=ext)
        for a in (a_n, a_r):
            pc = pads.cx[it["x"] - HALF:it["x"] + HALF, it["y"] - HALF:it["y"] + HALF]
            for g in pc.geometry:
                for poly in getattr(g, "geoms", [g]):
                    xs, ys = poly.exterior.xy
                    a.plot(np.array(xs) - it["x"], np.array(ys) - it["y"], color="white", lw=0.6)
            wc = wells.cx[it["x"] - HALF:it["x"] + HALF, it["y"] - HALF:it["y"] + HALF]
            a.scatter(wc.geometry.x - it["x"], wc.geometry.y - it["y"], s=10, marker="^",
                      facecolor=S.ORANGE, edgecolor="k", lw=0.4)
            if it["mark"]:
                a.scatter([0], [0], s=40, marker="o", facecolor="none", edgecolor=S.BLUE, lw=1.0)
            a.set_xlim(-HALF, HALF); a.set_ylim(-HALF, HALF)
        a_n.text(0.03, 0.97, it["label"], transform=a_n.transAxes, va="top", fontsize=6,
                 color="k", bbox=dict(fc="white", ec="none", pad=0.6))
    fig.text(0.5, 0.005, "Top of each pair NAIP June 2022, bottom lidar RRIM 2019. 80 m chips, north up. "
             "Blue circle NISAR target, orange triangle DEP well, white line lidar pad.",
             ha="center", fontsize=6.5)
    fig.subplots_adjust(wspace=0.04, hspace=0.04, bottom=0.03)
    p = FIG / f"{stem}_p{k}_9t.png"
    S.save(fig, p)


def main():
    srcs = [rasterio.open(u) for u in naip_urls()]
    rrim = rasterio.open(RRIM)
    wells = gpd.read_file(WELLS).to_crs("EPSG:32617")
    t = gpd.read_file(RES / "nisar_bright_targets_points_9t_slc.gpkg")
    pads = gpd.read_file(RES / "nisar_steel_pads_sites_9t_slc.gpkg")
    t = t.sort_values(["n_tracks", "bright_db"], ascending=False).head(40).reset_index(drop=True)
    rows = []
    items = []
    for i, r in t.iterrows():
        items.append(dict(x=r.geometry.x, y=r.geometry.y, mark=True,
                          label=f"T{i + 1} {r.n_tracks}tr {r.bright_db:.0f}dB {r.context}"))
        rows.append(dict(set="target", chip=f"T{i + 1}", id=int(r.target_id), n_tracks=int(r.n_tracks),
                         bright_db=round(r.bright_db, 1), context=r.context, x=r.geometry.x, y=r.geometry.y))
    for k in range(4):
        page(items[k * 10:(k + 1) * 10], srcs, rrim, wells, pads, "nisar_naip_chips_targets", k + 1)

    op = pads[pads.cover_cls == "open"].reset_index()
    items = []
    for i, r in op.iterrows():
        c = r.geometry.centroid
        hit = sum(int(r[f"t{t}"]) for t in (26, 90, 162))
        items.append(dict(x=c.x, y=c.y, mark=False, label=f"P{i + 1} {r.status_cls[:6]} hit{hit}"))
        rows.append(dict(set="open_pad", chip=f"P{i + 1}", id=int(r["site"]), status=r.status_cls,
                         hit_tracks=hit, x=c.x, y=c.y))
    for k in range(int(np.ceil(len(items) / 10))):
        page(items[k * 10:(k + 1) * 10], srcs, rrim, wells, pads, "nisar_naip_chips_open_pads", k + 1)
    pd.DataFrame(rows).to_csv(RES / "nisar_naip_chips_index_9t.csv", index=False)
    print("wrote", RES / "nisar_naip_chips_index_9t.csv")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```
### nisar/code/s7_analysis/_nisar_steel_pads_fig_9t.py
```python
"""Figure: steel screen at lidar pads vs same-shaped controls, 9t, lidar-placed stack. Set 2026-11-26.

Reads nisar/results/9t/nisar_steel_pads_summary_9t_slc.json (from s5_eval/_nisar_steel_pads_9t.py --slc).
Panel a: hit rate (any track) by class, all post-June dates. Panel b: separate rule pass rates per track.
Colours: pads #1F5FA8, controls #8E959B hatched (identity also by hatch and legend, never colour alone).
No red/green pair. Pair taken from the validated lost/found palette and the steel-test greys.
Writes nisar/results/9t/figures/nisar_steel_pads_hit_rate_9t_slc.png
Run: python nisar/code/s7_analysis/_nisar_steel_pads_fig_9t.py
"""
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "nisar" / "code"))
import _nisar_fig_style as S  # noqa: E402

RES = ROOT / "nisar" / "results" / "9t"
J = json.load(open(RES / "nisar_steel_pads_summary_9t_slc.json"))
BLUE, GREY = "#1F5FA8", "#8E959B"


def main():
    S.apply()
    t = [r for r in J["tests"] if r["dates"] == "all_post_june"]
    order = ["all", "cover_cls=open", "cover_cls=canopy", "size_cls=small", "size_cls=mid", "size_cls=large",
             "status_cls=active", "status_cls=plugged_or_abandoned", "status_cls=no_dep_well"]
    lab = {"all": "All pads", "cover_cls=open": "Open", "cover_cls=canopy": "Canopy", "size_cls=small": "Small",
           "size_cls=mid": "Mid", "size_cls=large": "Large", "status_cls=active": "Active well",
           "status_cls=plugged_or_abandoned": "Plugged/aband.", "status_cls=no_dep_well": "No DEP well"}
    rows = [next(r for r in t if r["cls"] == c) for c in order if any(r["cls"] == c for r in t)]
    fig, (a, b) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 4), gridspec_kw=dict(width_ratios=[2.2, 1]))
    x = np.arange(len(rows))
    a.bar(x - 0.2, [100 * r["pads_hit_any"] for r in rows], 0.4, color=BLUE, label="Lidar pads (+5 m)")
    a.bar(x + 0.2, [100 * r["ctrl_hit_any"] for r in rows], 0.4, color=GREY, hatch="///", ec="white",
          label="Same-shape controls")
    for i, r in enumerate(rows):
        a.text(i, 100 * max(r["pads_hit_any"], r["ctrl_hit_any"]) + 0.8, f"p={r['p_any']:.2g}\nn={r['n_pads']}",
               ha="center", fontsize=7)
    a.set_xticks(x); a.set_xticklabels([lab[r["cls"]] for r in rows], rotation=30, ha="right")
    a.set_ylabel("Sites with a steady bright pixel, any track (%)")
    a.set_title("a  Pads vs controls, post-June 2026", loc="left")
    a.set_ylim(0, 30); a.legend(frameon=False, fontsize=8, loc="upper left", ncol=2)
    pr = J["pass_rates"]["all_post_june"]
    tr = sorted(pr, key=int)
    xx = np.arange(len(tr))
    for k, (key, c, h, nm) in enumerate([("bright_pass", BLUE, None, "Brightness"),
                                          ("steady_pass", GREY, "///", "Steadiness"),
                                          ("both_pass", "#2B2F36", None, "Both")]):
        b.bar(xx + (k - 1) * 0.27, [100 * pr[t][key] for t in tr], 0.27, color=c, hatch=h, ec="white", label=nm)
    b.set_yscale("log"); b.set_xticks(xx); b.set_xticklabels([f"Track {t}" for t in tr])
    b.set_ylabel("Share of valid pixels (%)"); b.set_title("b  Rule pass rates", loc="left")
    b.legend(frameon=False, fontsize=8)
    fig.tight_layout()
    S.save(fig, RES / "figures" / "nisar_steel_pads_hit_rate_9t_slc.png")
    print("wrote", RES / "figures" / "nisar_steel_pads_hit_rate_9t_slc.png")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```
### nisar/code/s7_analysis/_nisar_pipeline_appendix_9t.py
```python
"""Build the full-code + full-metadata appendix for the NISAR 9t pipeline. Set 2026-11-26.

Why: nisar/docs/nisar_pipeline_spec_9t.md is the terse spec. This dumps everything behind it, machine
generated so nothing is retyped: per-granule metadata (index + RSLC HDF5 identification/parameters/orbit),
raster profiles, vector schemas, DEP status counts, every current result file, and the full source of
every pipeline script. Always the lidar-placed stack (NISAR_STACK=slc).
Out: nisar/docs/nisar_pipeline_appendix_9t.md
Run: python nisar/code/s7_analysis/_nisar_pipeline_appendix_9t.py
"""
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import geopandas as gpd
import h5py
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import rasterio

os.environ["NISAR_STACK"] = "slc"
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
N = ROOT / "nisar"
sys.path.insert(0, str(N / "code"))
import _nisar_area as A  # noqa: E402
from _common import path_for  # noqa: E402

OUT = N / "docs" / "nisar_pipeline_appendix_9t.md"
SCRIPTS = [
    "nisar/code/_nisar_area.py", "nisar/code/_nisar_fig_style.py", "notebooks/wellsight_v2/_common.py",
    "nisar/code/s1_build/_fetch_nisar_gslc_window_9t.py", "nisar/code/s1_build/_fetch_nisar_rslc_window_9t.py",
    "nisar/code/s1_build/_nisar_geometry.py", "nisar/code/s1_build/_nisar_regeocode_lidar_9t.py",
    "nisar/code/s5_eval/_nisar_lidar_sim_match_9t.py", "nisar/code/s5_eval/_nisar_gslc_stack_pad_pit_seasonal_9t.py",
    "nisar/code/s5_eval/_nisar_gslc_interferogram_pits_9t.py", "nisar/code/s5_eval/_nisar_steel_9t.py",
    "nisar/code/s5_eval/_nisar_steel_pads_9t.py", "nisar/code/s5_eval/_nisar_bright_targets_9t.py",
    "nisar/code/s5_eval/_nisar_pad_change_9t.py", "nisar/code/s5_eval/_nisar_pit_pool_9t.py",
    "nisar/code/s5_eval/_nisar_slope_motion_9t.py", "nisar/code/s7_analysis/_nisar_naip_chips_9t.py",
    "nisar/code/s7_analysis/_nisar_steel_pads_fig_9t.py", "nisar/code/s7_analysis/_nisar_pipeline_appendix_9t.py",
]
RESULTS = [
    "nisar_lidar_sim_match_summary_coregabs_k010_9t.json", "nisar_steel_summary_9t_slc.json",
    "nisar_steel_pads_summary_9t_slc.json", "nisar_bright_targets_summary_9t_slc.json",
    "nisar_gslc_stack_pad_pit_vs_decoy_summary_by_season_9t_slc_5m.json", "nisar_pad_change_summary_9t_slc.json",
    "nisar_gslc_interferogram_pits_vs_decoys_win3_9t_slc_5m_summary.json", "nisar_slope_motion_summary_9t_slc.json",
]
CSVS = ["nisar_steel_by_canopy_9t_slc.csv", "nisar_pad_change_by_season_9t_slc.csv", "nisar_pit_pool_radar_9t.csv",
        "nisar_top_targets_naip_classes_9t.csv", "nisar_slc_date_offsets_9t.csv", "nisar_slc_track_offsets_9t.csv"]
RUN = [
    "python nisar/code/s1_build/_fetch_nisar_gslc_window_9t.py",
    "python nisar/code/s1_build/_fetch_nisar_rslc_window_9t.py",
    "python nisar/code/s1_build/_nisar_regeocode_lidar_9t.py --v1 <pairs>          # reproduce NASA GSLC first",
    "python nisar/code/s1_build/_nisar_regeocode_lidar_9t.py --heights lidar --write",
    "python nisar/code/s1_build/_nisar_regeocode_lidar_9t.py --estimate-offsets",
    "python nisar/code/s1_build/_nisar_regeocode_lidar_9t.py --heights lidar --write --coreg",
    "python nisar/code/s5_eval/_nisar_lidar_sim_match_9t.py --stack lidar --kappa 0.1",
    "python nisar/code/s1_build/_nisar_regeocode_lidar_9t.py --track-offsets _coreg_k010",
    "python nisar/code/s1_build/_nisar_regeocode_lidar_9t.py --heights lidar --write --coreg --absolute",
    "python nisar/code/s5_eval/_nisar_lidar_sim_match_9t.py --stack lidar --kappa 0.1   # check -> coregabs_k010",
    "python nisar/code/s5_eval/_nisar_gslc_stack_pad_pit_seasonal_9t.py --slc",
    "python nisar/code/s5_eval/_nisar_gslc_interferogram_pits_9t.py --slc",
    "python nisar/code/s5_eval/_nisar_steel_9t.py --slc",
    "python nisar/code/s5_eval/_nisar_steel_pads_9t.py --slc",
    "python nisar/code/s5_eval/_nisar_bright_targets_9t.py --slc",
    "python nisar/code/s5_eval/_nisar_pad_change_9t.py --slc",
    "python nisar/code/s5_eval/_nisar_pit_pool_9t.py",
    "python nisar/code/s5_eval/_nisar_slope_motion_9t.py --slc",
    "python nisar/code/s7_analysis/_nisar_naip_chips_9t.py",
    "python nisar/code/s7_analysis/_nisar_steel_pads_fig_9t.py",
    "python nisar/code/s7_analysis/_nisar_pipeline_appendix_9t.py",
]


def val(d):
    v = d[()]
    if isinstance(v, bytes):
        return v.decode(errors="replace")
    if isinstance(v, np.ndarray):
        if v.dtype.kind == "S":
            v = [x.decode(errors="replace") for x in v.ravel()]
            return v if len(v) > 1 else v[0]
        return v.tolist()
    return v.item() if hasattr(v, "item") else v


def attrs(o):
    out = {}
    for k, v in o.attrs.items():
        out[k] = v.decode(errors="replace") if isinstance(v, bytes) else (v.tolist() if hasattr(v, "tolist") else v)
    return out


def h5dump(path, w, full_runconfig):
    with h5py.File(path, "r") as h:
        def visit(name, o):
            if not isinstance(o, h5py.Dataset):
                return
            if name.endswith("runConfigurationContents"):
                if full_runconfig:
                    w(f"- `{name}` (processor run configuration, verbatim):\n```yaml\n{val(o)}\n```")
                return
            if o.size > 12 and o.dtype.kind in "fciu":
                s = f"{o.dtype} {o.shape}"
                if o.size < 5e6 and o.dtype.kind != "c":
                    a = o[()]
                    s += f" min={np.nanmin(a):.6g} max={np.nanmax(a):.6g}"
            else:
                s = repr(val(o))
            at = attrs(o)
            w(f"- `{name}`: {s}" + (f" | attrs {at}" if at else ""))
        h.visititems(visit)


def main():
    L = []
    w = L.append
    w("# NISAR 9t pipeline appendix: full metadata, processes and code\n")
    w("Machine generated by `nisar/code/s7_analysis/_nisar_pipeline_appendix_9t.py`. Read with "
      "`nisar/docs/nisar_pipeline_spec_9t.md` (spec) and `nisar/docs/nisar_technical_writeup_9t.md` (narrative). "
      "Findings use only post-2026-06-01 9t data on the lidar-placed stack. No credentials included.\n")
    w("Contents: 1 granule index | 2 RSLC HDF5 metadata per granule | 3 GSLC + SLC raster metadata | "
      "4 lidar raster metadata | 5 vector schemas | 6 run order | 7 result files verbatim | 8 full source code\n")

    idx = A.usable(pd.read_csv(A.INDEX))
    w(f"## 1. Granule index (lidar-placed stack, used rows)\nSource `{A.INDEX.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()}`. {len(idx)} rows.\n")
    w(idx.to_markdown(index=False))
    g = pd.read_csv(N / "derived/9t/nisar_gslc_5m/nisar_gslc_window_index_9t_5m.csv")
    w(f"\nAll GSLC windows held, including excluded: {len(g)} rows. By collection and track:\n")
    w(g.groupby(["collection", "track"]).size().rename("n").reset_index().to_markdown(index=False))
    ex = g[~g.index.isin(A.usable(g).index)]
    cols = [c for c in ["file", "date", "collection", "track", "frame", "valid_fraction"] if c in ex]
    w("\nExcluded GSLC windows (before DATE_FLOOR, <50% valid, or BAD_DATES):\n")
    w(ex[cols].to_markdown(index=False))

    w("\n## 2. RSLC HDF5 metadata, per used granule\nWindow files hold NASA groups copied whole: identification, orbit, "
      "attitude, parameters (processingInformation/parameters), plus geolocationGrid and gslcTimingCorrections cut to the "
      "window. Large arrays summarised as dtype, shape, min, max. Processor run configuration printed once.\n")
    first = True
    for _, r in idx.iterrows():
        p = A.RSLC / str(r.rslc)
        if not p.exists():
            w(f"### {r.rslc}\nmissing on disk\n")
            continue
        w(f"### {r.date} track {r.track}{r.direction} `{p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()}`\n")
        h5dump(p, w, first)
        first = False
        w("")

    w("## 3. Raster metadata: GSLC window and lidar-placed SLC (one each; every date shares the grid)\n")
    used_g = A.usable(g)
    for p in [N / "derived/9t/nisar_gslc_5m" / used_g.file.iloc[-1], A.GSLC / idx.file.iloc[0]]:
        with rasterio.open(p) as s:
            pr = {k: str(v) for k, v in s.profile.items()}
            w(f"- `{p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()}`\n  - profile {pr}\n  - bounds {tuple(s.bounds)}\n"
              f"  - tags {s.tags()}\n  - band descriptions {s.descriptions}\n")

    w("## 4. Lidar, DEM and imagery rasters\n")
    for nm in ["dem", "chm", "slope", "hillshade"]:
        p = A.lidar(nm)
        if p.exists():
            with rasterio.open(p) as s:
                w(f"- `{nm}` `{p}`: crs {s.crs.to_string()}, res {s.res}, size {s.width}x{s.height}, "
                  f"dtype {s.dtypes[0]}, nodata {s.nodata}, bounds {tuple(round(b, 2) for b in s.bounds)}")
    rr = path_for("derived") / "9t" / "derived" / "05" / "rrim_openness_9t_05.tif"
    if rr.exists():
        with rasterio.open(rr) as s:
            w(f"- `rrim 0.5 m` `{rr}`: crs {s.crs.to_string()}, res {s.res}, size {s.width}x{s.height}, "
              f"bands {s.count} {s.dtypes[0]}")
    dem = N / "derived/9t/nisar_dem/DEM_N41_00_W080_00_C01.tif"
    if dem.exists():
        with rasterio.open(dem) as s:
            w(f"- `NISAR DEM v1.2` `{dem.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()}`: crs {s.crs.to_string()}, res {s.res}, "
              f"size {s.width}x{s.height}, dtype {s.dtypes[0]}")
    w("- NAIP: Planetary Computer STAC collection `naip`, 2022-06-19 over the 9t bbox, 0.6 m, 4-band uint8, "
      "NAD83 UTM 17N, read live through /vsicurl with an anonymous SAS token.\n")

    w("## 5. Vector data schemas and counts\n")
    ann = path_for("truth") / "annotations_proj.gpkg"
    for lay in ["plat", "pit_outside", "roads"]:
        try:
            d = gpd.read_file(ann, layer=lay)
            w(f"- `{ann.name}` layer `{lay}`: {len(d)} features, crs {d.crs}, geom {sorted(d.geom_type.unique())}, "
              f"columns {list(d.columns)}")
        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
            w(f"- layer {lay}: unreadable ({e})")
    wl = gpd.read_file(A.WELLS)
    b = A.bounds()
    w9 = wl.to_crs("EPSG:32617").cx[b[0]:b[2], b[1]:b[3]]
    w(f"- DEP wells `{A.WELLS.name}` (data/_source/reference/dep_wells/): {len(wl)} rows in export, {len(w9)} inside "
      f"9t lidar bounds, crs {wl.crs}, columns {list(wl.columns)}\n")
    w("WELL_STATU counts inside 9t lidar bounds:\n")
    w(w9.WELL_STATU.value_counts().rename_axis("WELL_STATU").reset_index().to_markdown(index=False))
    for f in ["nisar_steel_pads_sites_9t_slc.gpkg", "nisar_bright_targets_points_9t_slc.gpkg",
              "nisar_dep_well_pad_distance_9t.gpkg"]:
        p = A.RESULTS / f
        if p.exists():
            d = gpd.read_file(p)
            w(f"\n- `nisar/results/9t/{f}`: {len(d)} rows, columns {list(d.columns)}")

    w("\n## 6. Run order (reproduce from scratch)\n```")
    for c in RUN:
        w(c)
    w("```\nEnvironment: Python 3.13; h5py, fsspec + aiohttp, requests, rasterio/GDAL, geopandas, shapely, scipy, numpy, "
      "pandas, matplotlib. Earthdata login in ~/_netrc.\n")

    w("## 7. Result files (verbatim)\n")
    for f in RESULTS:
        p = A.RESULTS / f
        if p.exists():
            w(f"### nisar/results/9t/{f}\n```json\n{p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')}\n```")
    for f in CSVS:
        p = A.RESULTS / f
        if p.exists():
            w(f"### nisar/results/9t/{f}\n```csv\n{p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')}\n```")

    w("## 8. Full source code\n")
    for s in SCRIPTS:
        p = ROOT / s
        w(f"### {s}\n```python\n{p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')}\n```" if p.exists() else f"### {s}\nnot found")
    OUT.write_text("\n".join(str(x) for x in L), encoding="utf-8")
    print("wrote", OUT, f"{OUT.stat().st_size / 1e6:.2f} MB")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
